![](images/fnsouza.jpg)

content.text:
I built the site as a single static page, `index.html`, in the project folder. It uses the `images/` folder as it is, and I haven't opened it in a browser to check it.

It has these parts:
- **Header and hero:** a sticky header with the site navigation, then the abstract banner image with the foundation's name and the tagline "History & Works". On narrow screens the navigation collapses into a Menu button.
- **About:** the Souza portrait with the "Modern & Contemporary Art" text and a "Read more" button.
- **Photo gallery:** the six images, which open in an enlarged view when clicked. The eight artwork titles are listed below them.
- **News:** the statement clearing Francis Patrick Souza, with a link to it.
- **Contacts and login:** a contact form with a "Send message" button, and a login form with the "Remember me" option. Below the login form are the create-account, forgot-username and forgot-password links, and Facebook and Google + buttons.
- **Footer:** © 2021, the Privacy Policy link and the TemplateMonster credit.

Some things don't work the way a finished site would:
- **Larger gallery images:** the "larger image" files from the brief aren't in `images/`. The enlarged view shows the thumbnails, so swap in the full-size files when you have them.
- **Forms:** the contact and login forms are placeholders. Sending the contact form only shows a thank-you note, and neither form sends anything anywhere.
- **Social sign-in:** the Facebook and Google + buttons link nowhere.
- **Pages without a section:** Family History (English and Portuguese), the three Available For Sale pages, and the About "Read more" link point to the original fnsouzafoundation.com pages, because the brief has no content for them. The Home link does the same.

The About, Gallery, News and Contacts navigation items scroll to sections on the page.
